result.title: Learning to Compute Is Not Learning to Retain or Reuse in Looped Transformers
result.summary: Looped transformers compute by applying one block repeatedly, so they can run for more loops than they were trained with. Recurrent reasoners are known to overthink: iterating past the trained depth can turn a correct answer into a wrong one. Such a late error can reflect failed computation, loss of retention, or a state that later computation cannot reuse. We separate these cases in in-context Mealy-machine execution, where a simulator supplies intermediate targets and exact counterfactuals for hidden-state interventions. Models trained to answer at loop 32 are fully correct there but keep only 22% of these answers at loop 64. Retention depends on what training asks for: supervising one randomly chosen position per example, instead of always the last, keeps 99.8%, and randomizing the number of training loops also helps; truncating gradients, as in progressive training against overthinking, does not. The computation itself is exact: position $k$ is computed at loop $k$, and swapping its loop-$k$ hidden vector for the one from another input redirects every later position to that input's exact continuation (237/237 pairs in each of ten models). Retention, however, is not reuse. Even in models that keep nearly all answers, holding each position $k$ fixed from loop $k$ drops accuracy to 4--6%, whereas holding it from loop $k+4$ is harmless. A released recurrent maze network trained to avoid overthinking behaves the same way. Learning to compute is thus not learning to retain, and avoiding overthinking does not make a state reusable when its answer first appears.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在上下文 Mealy 机执行任务上研究 looped transformer：模型在训练循环深度内完全正确，循环加倍后仅保留 22% 答案；通过只监督随机位置、随机化训练循环数可把保留率提到 99.8%，而梯度截断无效；并用隐藏状态替换证明位置 k 的计算精确但对齐复用有限。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及 latent 循环推理的状态更新、过思考（overthinking）与停止/复用，明确区分「算得对」「留得住」「可复用」三类失败，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本、支持组合及循环长度泛化关注高度相关，其监督位置影响保留的结论可供核查。
